grammar_title: 状语从句复习(Adverbial Clauses):时间/地点 · 原因/条件/让步 · 目的/结果/方式/比较
source: 上外版必修第一册 Unit 3 Grammar in Use:Adverbial clauses (review)。句子地道、旅行主题;看从句与主句的逻辑关系定连词,答案唯一,零术语;干扰项为逻辑不通的其他连词。

points.point: 时间 / 地点状语从句(when/while/as/before/after/until/since · where/wherever)
points.overview: 表'什么时候/在哪里':时间用 when/while/as/before/after/until/since/as soon as;地点用 where/wherever。看从句表达的是'时间点'还是'地点'来选。

points.point: 原因 / 条件 / 让步状语从句(because/since/as · if/unless · though/although/even if)
points.overview: 原因(给理由)用 because/since/as;条件(如果/除非)用 if/unless/as long as;让步(尽管/即使)用 though/although/even if。看主从句是'因果''假设'还是'转折'。

points.point: 目的 / 结果 / 方式 / 比较状语从句(so that/in order that · so…that/such…that · as if/as though · than)
points.overview: 目的(为了)用 so that/in order that;结果(如此…以至于)用 so…that/such…that;方式(好像)用 as if/as though;比较(比)用 than。看是'目的''结果''仿佛'还是'比较'。

questions.stem: I always feel excited ____ the plane finally takes off for a new country.
questions.explanation: 表'……的时候'起飞,是时间关系 → when。

questions.stem: ____ we were walking along the river, a cold wind began to blow.
questions.explanation: 两个动作同时进行(走路时起风)→ 时间 while。

questions.stem: We talked about our plans ____ we walked back to the hotel.
questions.explanation: '一边……一边……',边走边聊 → 时间 as。

questions.stem: Remember to book the tickets ____ you leave for the airport.
questions.explanation: 订票在出发'之前' → 时间 before。

questions.stem: ____ we arrived in Rome, we went straight to see the ancient ruins.
questions.explanation: 先到达后参观,先后顺序 → 时间 after。

questions.stem: The tourists waited at the gate ____ the museum opened.
questions.explanation: 一直等到开门为止 → 时间 until。

questions.stem: Eleanor has stayed in this hotel ____ she arrived in the city.
questions.explanation: 从到达起一直住到现在 → 时间 since。

questions.stem: ____ the tour guide finished speaking, everyone started taking photos.
questions.explanation: 一……就……,导游讲完马上拍照 → 时间 as soon as。

questions.stem: This is the small square ____ street artists paint pictures for tourists.
questions.explanation: 表'在……地方'画画 → 地点 where。

questions.stem: ____ you travel in this region, you will find friendly local people.
questions.explanation: '无论在哪里'旅行 → 地点 wherever。

questions.stem: I felt a little nervous ____ the train slowly pulled out of the station.
questions.explanation: 随着火车开出(同时)→ 时间 as。

questions.stem: We should check the weather ____ we set off on the mountain trip.
questions.explanation: 查天气在出发'之前' → 时间 before。

questions.stem: ____ I was buying souvenirs, my friend was booking our train tickets.
questions.explanation: 两动作同时进行(买纪念品时订票)→ 时间 while。

questions.stem: The children kept asking questions ____ the bus reached the seaside.
questions.explanation: 一直问到到达海边为止 → 时间 until。

questions.stem: Edinburgh is the city ____ many famous writers once lived and worked.
questions.explanation: 表'在……城市'居住工作 → 地点 where。

questions.stem: ____ the holiday ended, we promised to travel together again next year.
questions.explanation: 假期结束的'时候' → 时间 when。

questions.stem: He has loved travelling ____ he took his first solo trip at sixteen.
questions.explanation: 从十六岁第一次独自旅行起 → 时间 since。

questions.stem: Please put a sticker on the map ____ you have already visited a place.
questions.explanation: '在凡是去过的地方'贴贴纸 → 地点 wherever。

questions.stem: We had dinner at a riverside café ____ the sun was setting over the water.
questions.explanation: 随着太阳西落的'同时' → 时间 as。

questions.stem: ____ you check out of the hotel, make sure you take everything with you.
questions.explanation: 退房'之前'拿好东西 → 时间 before。

questions.stem: We chose to travel by train ____ it was cheaper than flying.
questions.explanation: 给出'选火车'的理由(更便宜)→ 原因 because。

questions.stem: ____ Eleanor is a first-time visitor, she would like to hire a guide.
questions.explanation: 句首给已知原因(她是初次来)→ 原因 since。

questions.stem: ____ it was getting dark, we decided to head back to the hotel.
questions.explanation: 句首引出原因(天黑了)→ 原因 as。

questions.stem: We won't be able to see the old town ____ we get up early tomorrow.
questions.explanation: '除非'早起,否则看不到 → 条件 unless。

questions.stem: ____ it rains tomorrow, we will visit the museum instead of the beach.
questions.explanation: '如果'下雨(真实条件)→ 条件 if。

questions.stem: You can keep the carry-on bag ____ it weighs less than ten kilograms.
questions.explanation: '只要'不超重就可以 → 条件 as long as。

questions.stem: He enjoyed the package tour ____ he disliked the very tight schedule.
questions.explanation: 喜欢却又不喜欢日程,前后转折 → 让步 even though。

questions.stem: ____ the journey was long and tiring, the beautiful views made it worth it.
questions.explanation: 辛苦但值得,转折关系 → 让步 although。

questions.stem: I still remember the Terracotta Warriors clearly ____ I went there years ago.
questions.explanation: 多年前去过却仍记得,转折 → 让步 though。

questions.stem: We had to take a taxi to the station ____ there were no buses that early.
questions.explanation: 给出'打车'的原因(没有公交)→ 原因 because。

questions.stem: ____ you are not sure how much luggage you can take, ask the airline first.
questions.explanation: '如果'不确定(假设)→ 条件 if。

questions.stem: ____ Chris prefers a city with history, I will recommend Xi'an to him.
questions.explanation: 句首给已知原因(他偏爱历史名城)→ 原因 since。

questions.stem: We can't get closer to the sea lions ____ we have enough time today.
questions.explanation: '除非'有足够时间,否则靠不近 → 条件 unless。

questions.stem: ____ the food was a bit expensive, the restaurant was packed with tourists.
questions.explanation: 贵却还是满座,转折 → 让步 although。

questions.stem: I'd love to visit Europe ____ my parents agree to pay for the flight.
questions.explanation: '如果'父母同意(条件)→ 条件 if。

questions.stem: We took lots of photos ____ we wanted to remember every moment of the trip.
questions.explanation: 给出'拍很多照片'的理由 → 原因 because。

questions.stem: ____ a setback may slow you down, it should never stop your travel dreams.
questions.explanation: '即使'有挫折(让步)→ 让步 even if。

questions.stem: The trip cost less ____ we shared one room and cooked our own meals.
questions.explanation: 给出'花费更少'的原因(合住自炊)→ 原因 because。

questions.stem: You won't enjoy the hike ____ you wear a pair of comfortable walking shoes.
questions.explanation: '除非'穿舒适的鞋,否则不会享受 → 条件 unless。

questions.stem: ____ she was tired after the flight, she went out to explore the city at once.
questions.explanation: 累却立刻出门,转折 → 让步 although。

questions.stem: She downloaded a travel app ____ she could plan the whole trip on her phone.
questions.explanation: 下载 app 是'为了'能用手机规划 → 目的 so that。

questions.stem: We left home very early ____ we might catch the first train to the coast.
questions.explanation: 早出门是'为了'赶上首班车 → 目的 in order that。

questions.stem: The view from the hill was ____ beautiful that nobody wanted to leave.
questions.explanation: so + 形容词 beautiful + that → 结果 so…that。

questions.stem: It was ____ a breathtaking ceiling that I couldn't tear my eyes away from it.
questions.explanation: such + a + 形容词 + 名词 ceiling → 结果 such…that。

questions.stem: The old explorer described the cave ____ he had walked through it yesterday.
questions.explanation: '好像'昨天才走过(实际很久前)→ 方式 as if。

questions.stem: This seaside town attracts far more visitors in summer ____ it does in winter.
questions.explanation: more…than,夏天比冬天多 → 比较 than。

questions.stem: I kept a careful diary ____ I could remember every place we visited.
questions.explanation: 记日记是'为了'记住去过的地方 → 目的 so that。

questions.stem: The guide spoke slowly ____ the foreign tourists could follow her words.
questions.explanation: 说慢是'为了'让游客听懂 → 目的 in order that。

questions.stem: The square was ____ crowded that we could hardly move toward the fountain.
questions.explanation: so + 形容词 crowded + that → 结果 so…that。

questions.stem: It was ____ a long flight that everyone fell asleep before the meal arrived.
questions.explanation: such + a + 形容词 + 名词 flight → 结果 such…that。

questions.stem: He talked about the ancient city ____ he had lived there all his life.
questions.explanation: '仿佛'他一直住在那里 → 方式 as though。

questions.stem: Travelling by high-speed train is much faster ____ travelling by coach.
questions.explanation: faster…than,比坐长途汽车快 → 比较 than。

questions.stem: Pack your bag the night before ____ you won't be in a rush in the morning.
questions.explanation: 前一晚收拾是'为了'早上不慌乱 → 目的 so that。

questions.stem: We booked the hotel early ____ we would have a room near the old town.
questions.explanation: 早订房是'为了'有靠近老城的房间 → 目的 in order that。

questions.stem: The waves were ____ high that the boat trip had to be put off until Monday.
questions.explanation: so + 形容词 high + that → 结果 so…that。

questions.stem: It was ____ a wonderful holiday that we are already planning the next one.
questions.explanation: such + a + 形容词 + 名词 holiday → 结果 such…that。

questions.stem: The little girl pointed at the map ____ she already knew the whole country.
questions.explanation: '好像'她已熟知整个国家 → 方式 as if。

questions.stem: A guided tour usually costs more ____ exploring a city on your own does.
questions.explanation: more…than,跟团比自由行贵 → 比较 than。

questions.stem: Keep your passport in your hand luggage ____ you can reach it quickly.
questions.explanation: 放手提行李是'为了'能快速拿到 → 目的 so that。

questions.stem: The terracotta figures were ____ lifelike that visitors gasped in surprise.
questions.explanation: so + 形容词 lifelike + that → 结果 so…that。
